description: M4-13: long training run of the M4-12 causal GRU-CTC decoder (fidetype.decoders.lookahead_gru, model unchanged, L 0 only) on B2T '25 T15. M4-12 recipe plus a longer step budget and 4-days-per-batch sampling. See plan.md.
dataset: Card et al. 2024 (NEJM), t15_copyTask_neuralData.zip, Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.dncjsxm85 (CC0 1.0). Same derived inputs as M4-01/02 and M4-12 (same prep, same splits), read only.
derived_dir_note: READ ONLY: features, texts, sessions. This task never writes there.

splits.train: the dataset 'train' trials of all sessions (8,065 used before the length filter)
splits.val_select: dataset 'val' trials with an even index inside their session (checkpoint selection and progress only)
splits.val_eval: dataset 'val' trials with an odd index inside their session (reported numbers; 701 trials; decoded once at the end)

train.total_steps_note: sized by the smoke test (bucket sampler, batch 64: 1.33-1.42 s per step) to about 45 h (plan.md)
train.sampler_note: bucket = M4-12 batches (all days mixed, length buckets, max_batch_bins cap). days / days_band (4 days per batch) were smoke-tested: 5.4-6.0 s per step, not feasible (plan.md)
